The React Native client in all twelve skins

Six skins, each in dark and light, across 7 screens — 84 device captures. The committed goldens pin one skin×mode per scenario and so cover two of these twelve cells; this page is the look at the other ten that Phase 7's sign-off asked for. Each row reads classic · holo · holo3d · terminal · terminal3d · neon.

How this was made. The same static, frozen scenarios the goldens use, re-shot on an iPhone 17 simulator (iOS 26.5) with tests/visual/simctl/run.ts --scratch --skin=<skin>:<mode> at c39b9b963, then reduced to 570px WebP (q80) and inlined so the page is one file. Nothing here is pinned or diffed: these captures are for a person to look at, and the runner refuses --skin without --scratch. Regenerate with docs/showcase/tools/build_skin_sweep.py (its docstring has both steps). Authoritative notes: Phase 7 in docs/rn-open-items.md §6 and the sweep section of packages/client-react-native/tests/visual/README.md.
